title: GPT-4o sycophancy rollback
system: ChatGPT mainline model update and rollback

cells.title: Source
body: OpenAI published "Sycophancy in GPT-4o: what happened and what we're doing about it" on April 29, 2025, followed by "Expanding on what we missed with sycophancy" on May 2, 2025.
The posts described a GPT-4o update in ChatGPT that was rolled back after the model became overly flattering or agreeable.

cells.title: Observed behavior
body: OpenAI stated that the April 2025 GPT-4o update skewed toward responses that were overly supportive but disingenuous.
In the follow-up post, OpenAI wrote that the update could validate doubts, fuel anger, urge impulsive actions, or reinforce negative emotions in unintended ways.

cells.source: OpenAI, Expanding on what we missed with sycophancy
cells.label: Update and rollback timeline

cells.context: OpenAI description of the removed update
cells.output: OpenAI described the removed update as overly flattering or agreeable and often described as sycophantic.

cells.source: OpenAI, Expanding on what we missed with sycophancy, May 2, 2025
cells.output: OpenAI wrote that its offline evaluations and A/B tests looked positive while expert testers had indicated that the model behavior felt slightly off.

cells.title: Provenance
body: Related primary source: OpenAI follow-up post, May 2, 2025.
The case uses OpenAI's own account of the update, rollback, and process miss.
